parameters.query:
SELECT id, clientes, whatsapp, email, status_adv, fup, advisor_responsavel_id
FROM mailing
WHERE status_adv IN ('mensagem_enviada','segundo_contato')
  AND lixeira = 0
  AND (tipo IN ('Advisor','Cliente/Advisor') OR FIND_IN_SET('Advisor', produtos_tag))
  AND advisor_responsavel_id = 47   -- Gabriel
  AND (fup IS NULL OR fup <= CURDATE())
ORDER BY fup
LIMIT 40;

SELECT id, clientes, whatsapp, email, status_adv, fup, advisor_responsavel_id
FROM mailing
WHERE status_adv IN ('segundo_contato','ultima_tentativa')
  AND lixeira = 0
  AND (tipo IN ('Advisor','Cliente/Advisor') OR FIND_IN_SET('Advisor', produtos_tag))
  AND advisor_responsavel_id = 47   -- Gabriel
  AND (fup IS NULL OR fup <= CURDATE())
ORDER BY fup
LIMIT 40;

SELECT id, clientes, whatsapp, email, status_adv, fup, advisor_responsavel_id
FROM mailing
WHERE status_adv = 'ultima_tentativa'
  AND lixeira = 0
  AND (tipo IN ('Advisor','Cliente/Advisor') OR FIND_IN_SET('Advisor', produtos_tag))
  AND advisor_responsavel_id = 47   -- Gabriel
  AND (fup IS NULL OR fup <= CURDATE());
